decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01A, OS-01, Wall Elevation to Parr Court (Existing), Wall Elevation to Parr Court (Proposed), Wall Elevation to Tudor Court, Design & Access Statement, Structural Assessment, Planning Statement, Historic Building Investigation Received 13/04/2011) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of all new brickwork and mortar, including works of making good and the detailed profile and finishing of the proposed buttresses, have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
description: Repair to a wall of Tudor origin. Works including removal and rebuilding of upper courses, removal of vegetation and gentle cleaning, repointing of unsuitable or severely damaged bricks, and the construction of piled buttresses to replace the temporary propping.
